items.ruling_applied: manual §1.1 C7 (IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma counts as named)
items.reason: Inclusion requires 'malignant glioma (defined as WHO grade III or IV)' and 'Gliomas with Isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild-type status'; C7 counts an IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma as named glioblastoma, and grade III IDH-wildtype glioma is also eligible, so it is mixed. This is stronger than the R7 case because IDH-wildtype is required.

items.coder_A: Glioblastoma is not named literally; eligibility combines WHO grade III or IV malignant glioma with IDH-wildtype, which includes IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma (=GBM) but could be read as high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

note: Moot: diagnostic 18F-FET PET study with no therapeutic agent, so excluded at S6 regardless; reason set to excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1 (the PET/CT diagnostic test is a non-drug intervention under test). Population kept as mixed_glioma_gbm_named (grade III or IV with IDH-wildtype required, which includes IDH-wildtype grade 4 glioma under C7 and is stronger than D30-R7); if XL reads D31-B5 ('an IDH-wildtype cohort does not qualify') as covering this wording it would be high_grade_glioma_unspecified and a near-miss, with no effect on the S6 exclusion. Treatment setting left unclear (post-RT enlarging lesions that may be pseudoprogression).

revisions.reason: The tested intervention is a diagnostic test ('[DIAGNOSTIC_TEST] FET PET', a single 18F-FET PET/CT), a non-drug procedure; 18F-FET itself is a diagnostic_agent.
